information.description:
Personal Drone (four-legged). MOVE 8, SP11, 25 HP, Combat Number 10, roams 50m. Bite: Exotic Very Heavy Melee. Motion Detector, Olfactory Suite. Can't be Countered by Electronics/Security Tech. Linked to one Holophone (5 minutes to re-link, both Holophones within 6m). Modes (switch free): Standby; Sentry (stays within 8m, Perception = CN over 50m, attacks threats to you, can't dodge bullets); Tracking (Action to give it a scent; Tracking = CN; no attacks, dodges melee). 48 hours per charge.

Cost: 5,000eb

Item Compendium (2070) • Gear & Goods

Art: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.
